cards.in_the_file: Oye, jefe. Two days no food. I don't want batteries, just something to eat. My brother says ask the ones with guns, they got food.
cards.line: Oye, jefe. Two days no food. I don't want batteries, just something to eat. My brother says ask the ones with guns, they got food.

cards.in_the_file: The House holds this road, and you did not pay to use it.
cards.line: The House holds this road, and you did not pay to use it.

cards.in_the_file: they don't know I have two jugs of water under the bed.
cards.line: they don't know I have two jugs of water under the bed.

cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.in_the_file: Seven of them, big as ponies, and they come when the water comes. We cannot pay what you are worth, only {pay} batteries, and if you say no it is fine, everybody says no.
cards.line: Seven of them, big as ponies, and they come when the water comes. We cannot pay what you are worth, only 199 batteries, and if you say no it is fine, everybody says no.

cards.in_the_file: Ka-ching.
cards.line: Ka-ching.

cards.in_the_file: Inspección. What's in the wagon, jefe? We take a tenth of everything, it's the law now. Our law. Or you can try to argue.
cards.line: Inspección. What's in the wagon, jefe? We take a tenth of everything, it's the law now. Our law. Or you can try to argue.

cards.in_the_file: Bienvenido. Batteries talk here, so keep yours where we can hear them.
cards.line: Bienvenido. Batteries talk here, so keep yours where we can hear them.

cards.in_the_file: His boots are my size. He won't mind.
cards.line: His boots are my size. He won't mind.

cards.in_the_file: My crew ate each other over a water tank. I walked. I can walk with you.
cards.line: My crew ate each other over a water tank. I walked. I can walk with you.

cards.in_the_file: tower. please answer.
cards.line: tower. please answer.

cards.in_the_file: Boss, the battery box is light. Six short. I counted twice. It was me. My sister in Henderson has a boy on an oxygen machine, and the machine eats batteries. I was going to tell you.
cards.line: Boss, the battery box is light. Six short. I counted twice. It was me. My sister in Henderson has a boy on an oxygen machine, and the machine eats batteries. I was going to tell you.

cards.in_the_file: You have been asking about me all over the valley, and here I am.
cards.line: You have been asking about me all over the valley, and here I am.

cards.who: A MAN IN A POLO SHIRT
cards.in_the_file: Folks! Ninety minutes of your time and breakfast is on us. Real eggs: we keep chickens on the roof now. Vacation ownership is still the smartest money in Nevada. Ask me about week thirty-two.
cards.line: Folks! Ninety minutes of your time and breakfast is on us. Real eggs: we keep chickens on the roof now. Vacation ownership is still the smartest money in Nevada. Ask me about week thirty-two.

cards.in_the_file: I buy and I sell. Half what I charge, more for what this town is short of. No haggling, mijo.
cards.line: I buy and I sell. Half what I charge, more for what this town is short of. No haggling.

cards.in_the_file: {name}! Don't you dare.
cards.line: DESI! Don't you dare.

cards.in_the_file: I ring it for the ones in the houses who died alone after the money went. Nobody came for them, so I come. Every night a different street. Tonight it's this one. Stand with me a minute, hijo, it's only a minute.
cards.line: I ring it for the ones in the houses who died alone after the money went. Nobody came for them, so I come. Every night a different street. Tonight it's this one. Stand with me a minute, hijo, it's only a minute.

cards.in_the_file: A trucker swore he saw a dog with a tag in its ear, big as a calf, out by the tower. From the lab, pues.
cards.line: A trucker swore he saw a dog with a tag in its ear, big as a calf, out by the tower. From the lab.

cards.in_the_file: the refinery horn still goes off at six every morning. there's no shift anymore. my husband still gets up for it.
cards.line: the refinery horn still goes off at six every morning. there's no shift anymore. my husband still gets up for it.

cards.in_the_file: I fed the whole Strip once. I can feed your crew on half of what you are wasting.
cards.line: I fed the whole Strip once. I can feed your crew on half of what you are wasting.

cards.in_the_file: Batteries or nothing, carnal. Nobody takes paper since the dollar died.
cards.line: Batteries or nothing, carnal. Nobody takes paper since the dollar died.
